alternatives.name: Lighting New York
alternatives.endpoint: Direct image: https://lightingnewyork.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-master-catalog-lny/default/brand/ara/productimages/<SKU>.jpg (also .webp variants exist); product pages have JSON-LD Product with sku/mpn and og:image; search: /search?q=<SKU>
alternatives.notes: Reachable with browser headers (HTTP 200). Direct image path works without the dw hash segment; nonexistent SKU returns HTTP 404 (no placeholder), so existence check is reliable. High-res (~1938px) JPEGs, no watermark observed. 5/5 tested SKUs found.

alternatives.name: Greer Lighting Center
alternatives.notes: HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge - not usable.

recommended_strategy: Official site has no harvestable catalog (encrypted Flutter/ERP API, UUID image names). Use Lighting New York: for each SKU (strip leading apostrophe), GET https://lightingnewyork.com/on/demandware.static/-/Sites-master-catalog-lny/default/brand/ara/productimages/<SKU>.jpg; 200 => use it, 404 => try .webp, then fall back to /search?q=<SKU> -> product page JSON-LD/og:image. Throttle ~1 req/s. Remaining misses: extract from official PDF catalog manually.
blockers: Official shop API is encrypted (AES key in JS + session id) - not used; no sitemap/product feed on official site. Greer Lighting behind Cloudflare challenge.
